name: Bantay safety broadcast (DO NOT ACTIVATE until reviewed)

nodes.name: Broadcast webhook
nodes.notes: Called by the admin screen: POST {"t":"storm_warning"} with the admin's Supabase access token as Bearer. VITE_BROADCAST_URL in the app build = this production URL.

nodes.name: Is caller admin (Supabase verifies the JWT)
nodes.notes: Calls public.is_admin() as the caller, so a bad or expired token gets a non-true answer and a disabled admin is refused. n8n env: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (publishable key only, not the service key).

nodes.name: Load push subscriptions
nodes.notes: Reads every device's subscription with the service role, which only this workflow holds. Column names follow lane A2's push_subscriptions in 0003_sync.sql: adjust if they differ. Never reads health tables.

main.node: Is caller admin (Supabase verifies the JWT)
